---
title: "Blog"
description: "Notes on data science, data engineering and code — written in Quarto with R and Python."
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: true
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: true
  feed: true
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
# List / cards view switch. The choice is kept in localStorage ("pt-blog-view").
# The class goes on <html> before first paint so the page never flashes the wrong view;
# the CSS for both views lives in theme/pixel.scss ("blog: list / cards views").
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <script>
        try { if (localStorage.getItem("pt-blog-view") === "cards")
          document.documentElement.classList.add("pt-view-cards"); } catch (e) {}
      </script>
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script>
      (function () {
        var bar = document.querySelector("#listing-listing .listing-actions-group");
        if (!bar) return;
        var root = document.documentElement, key = "pt-blog-view";
        var sw = document.createElement("div");
        sw.className = "pt-view-switch";
        sw.setAttribute("role", "group");
        sw.setAttribute("aria-label", "Layout");
        sw.innerHTML =
          '<button type="button" data-view="list" title="List view"><i class="bi bi-list-ul"></i><span>list</span></button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-view="cards" title="Card view"><i class="bi bi-grid"></i><span>cards</span></button>';
        bar.appendChild(sw);
        function set(view) {
          root.classList.toggle("pt-view-cards", view === "cards");
          sw.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) {
            b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.view === view));
          });
          try { localStorage.setItem(key, view); } catch (e) {}
        }
        sw.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
          var b = e.target.closest("button");
          if (b) set(b.dataset.view);
        });
        set(root.classList.contains("pt-view-cards") ? "cards" : "list");
      })();
      </script>
---
